description: This file defines a Retrofit API interface 'MockApiService' for a demo application, providing mocked network endpoints for login, token refresh, and accessing a protected resource, served by a local interceptor.

classes.name: MockApiService
classes.description: Retrofit interface defining mock network endpoints for authentication and protected resource access.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Suspending function that posts login credentials to obtain a token response.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Suspending function that posts refresh request to obtain a new token response.

methods.name: protectedResource
methods.description: Suspending function that performs a GET request to access a protected resource.
